procedure_file: extraction_procedure_social_addendum_v1.4_social science Classes 6-10 on top of procedure v2.md

second_method.method: independent count of answer-side keys (48 numbered keys + 1 unnumbered match block(s)) + 1 question(s) with no printed key

count_gate.note: No difficulty distribution table is printed in this LBA -> quota_table 'absent' (ruling R-E6). Question side labels 1-50 monotonic, no gaps or duplicates. Answer side 1-25, [match block], 27-49 by printed number; the numbered list 1.-10. inside key 45 is part of that key; q050 (draw) has no key. Difficulty per question: easy 37, average 2, difficult 8, untagged 3.

method_notes: Pages: Q pdf 79 (heading, LO) 80-83; A pdf 175 (heading, key 1) 176-179.

Sections: s1 MCQ q1-5; s2 fill q6-15; s3 T/F q16-25; s4 '26. Match the following appropriately (easy)' q26 (10 rows; Q-side labels garbled e)/(r)/(a)); s5 one mark q27-33 vsa; s6 two marks q34-38 sa; s7 three marks q39-43 sa; s8 four marks q44-50 la (heading untagged; q44-46 untagged).
KEY SIDE ANALYSED FIRST: no displacement. The survey's 'labels 1-10 repeated after 45' is the numbered list of ten occupations printed inside key 45 (pdf 178) -> ten lines/steps of q45, not keys.

Keys: one-line or wrapped prose (joined); q40, q42, q43, q47 bullets; key 27 and 30 print teacher notes '(Accept any correct occupation)', '(Any one from Ramanahalli)' — kept verbatim. q50 draw -> 'no answer printed'.
Transcription: evs_auto.py rules (as evs-4-01) + the overrides in build file build_19.py; marks per ruling R-E5; topic per R-E3.
